frontal_spatial_matrix.muzzle_spot_diameter: The individual solid spots on the anterior muzzle are significantly smaller than the nasal pad, with a relative diameter estimated at less than 10% of the total nasal pad width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a small, focal reddish lesion or fresh superficial wound on the lower philtrum, slightly to the right of the vertical midline.
